text: {"lessons":["I will judge each stock by its outlook, not just whether it is above or below my average cost; selling Stock D below cost made the loss real, but holding solely to avoid a loss would not be a sound rule either.","My account moved both up and down over a few months, so I will avoid reacting to short-term changes without a clear reason.","I will keep diversification and my ten-year apartment goal in mind, and make sure any stock purchases fit my available cash and overall plan."]}
